Sanitized Contradiction Notice for C2Pro fixture validation.

The contract instruction states that the north stair enclosure must be completed
before the end of week four, but the attached logistics note states that access
to the same enclosure will remain blocked until week six. The Contract
Administrator also issued a budget freeze for temporary access works while the
site instruction requires a new temporary scaffold to start immediately.

The scope register says the contractor is responsible for fire stopping around
new service penetrations. A later clarification says fire stopping is excluded
from the contractor package and will be completed by others. This creates a
scope ownership contradiction, a schedule contradiction, and a likely budget
overrun if the work is not assigned before inspection.
